title: Canonical-reduction criterion for constructible completeness
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, d its integral datum, and T a Noetherian scheme. For K in the completed coefficient derived category [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], assume every canonical reduction has cohomology supported in [a,b], allowing a>b. Then K is bounded constructible complete if and only if it is intrinsically complete and, at every positive quotient level, the homologyProperty clause of [def-weil-pbc-uniform-reduction-profile] holds for its constant reduction. This criterion is only asserted for the integral datum.

proof.text: Apply the forward uniform criterion to the local-model and compatible-origin clauses of membership. Retain completeness and the cohomology clause of its uniform profile.

Exact restriction along pbcLevelConstantComparison transports the given cohomology bounds to constant reductions. On [min a b,b] these bounds and the given homologyProperty are PbcUniformReductionProfile. Apply pbcUniformReductionCriterion_backward and pair the two witness clauses with completeness.

lean.statement:
theorem pbc_constructible_reduction_criterion
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (a b : ℤ)
    (K : PbcCompletedDerived T (pbcIntegralDatum l E))
    (hbounded : ∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ), (q < a ∨ b < q) →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
        ((pbcCompletedReduction T (pbcIntegralDatum l E) n).obj K))) :
    PbcIsBoundedConstructibleComplete T (pbcIntegralDatum l E) K ↔
      PbcIsIntrinsicallyComplete T (pbcIntegralDatum l E) K ∧
        ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory.homologyProperty
          (@IsConstructibleProEtaleCoefficientModuleSheaf T
            (PbcQuotient (pbcIntegralDatum l E) n) _
            ((pbcIntegralDatum l E).quotientFinite n))
          ((pbcConstantReduction T (pbcIntegralDatum l E) n).obj K)
